description_en: It can quickly and accurately detect key field information from a Food Operation License, including the producer name, unified social credit code, legal representative name, address, production site, food category, validity period, license number, and more
description_zh: 可快速精准的识别食品经营许可证所包含生产者名称、社会信用代码、法定代表人姓名、地址、生产场所、食品类别、有效期、许可证编号等关键字段信息
kebab_example: aliyun ocr-api recognize-food-manage-license --url 'https://jidongstore.oss-cn-shanghai.aliyuncs.com/uploads/test/食品经营许可证/食品经营许可证_306699206393969_J210500_null.jpg' --biz-body '图片二进制文件' --region cn-hangzhou
name: RecognizeFoodManageLicense

parameters.example: https://jidongstore.oss-cn-shanghai.aliyuncs.com/uploads/test/食品经营许可证/食品经营许可证_306699206393969_J210500_null.jpg
parameters.help_en:
This field and the body field are mutually exclusive; you must provide one and only one of them.  
Image URL (must not exceed 2048 bytes in length; base64 is not supported).
parameters.help_zh:
本字段和body字段二选一，不可同时透传或同时为空。
图片链接（长度不超2048字节，不支持base64）
parameters.name: url

parameters.help_en:
This field and the URL field are mutually exclusive; you must provide one and only one of them.  
Binary file of the image, up to 10 MB in size.  
When using HTTP invocation, upload the binary file of the image in the HTTP body.  
When using the software development kit (SDK), place the image in the SDK body.
parameters.help_zh:
本字段和URL字段二选一，不可同时透传或同时为空。
图片二进制文件，最大10MB。
使用HTTP方式调用，把图片二进制文件放到HTTP body中上传即可。
使用SDK的方式调用，把图片放到SDK的body中即可
parameters.name: body
